Container.Name: beszel-agent-gpu
Container.Overview: Beszel monitoring agent with Nvidia GPU support. The beszel-agent image is distroless (no glibc), so this template bind-mounts the host's dynamic linker, C libraries and nvidia-smi into the container.[br][br]After an Nvidia driver upgrade, update the versioned libnvidia-ml host path and the ld-linker host path. See docs/gpu-setup.md for discovery commands.

Config.Name: KEY
Config.Description: SSH public key from the hub (Settings → Keys). Required for the agent to authenticate with the hub.

Config.Name: SENSORS_EXCLUDE
Config.Description: Comma-separated sensor names to exclude. The default suppresses phantom sensors common on Supermicro/ASUS server boards. Run 'sensors -u' on the host to discover your actual sensor names.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Docker socket for container stats reporting. Read-only.

Config.Name: nvidia-smi
Config.Description: Nvidia system management interface binary. Path is standard on Unraid.

Config.Name: ld-linker
Config.Description: ELF dynamic linker. Host path must be the REAL file, not the symlink. Run: readlink -f /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2

Config.Name: libpthread
Config.Description: POSIX threads library. Path is standard on Unraid.

Config.Name: libm
Config.Description: Math library. Path is standard on Unraid.

Config.Name: libdl
Config.Description: Dynamic linking library. Path is standard on Unraid.

Config.Name: libc
Config.Description: GNU C library. Path is standard on Unraid.

Config.Name: librt
Config.Description: POSIX realtime extensions library. Path is standard on Unraid.

Config.Name: libnvidia-ml (versioned)
Config.Description: Versioned Nvidia ML library. BOTH host and container paths contain the driver version. After a driver upgrade, run: nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv,noheader — then update both paths.

Config.Name: libnvidia-ml.so.1
Config.Description: Nvidia ML soname symlink. Path is standard.

Config.Name: libnvidia-ml.so
Config.Description: Nvidia ML development symlink. Path is standard.
